text: ディグダが　ほったんだと！

structure.jp: ディグダが　ほったんだと！

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と at the very end passes on what other people said, with 'they say' left unspoken. ほったんだと = 'they say it dug it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ, added when giving the story behind something. ほったんだ = 'it's that it dug it'.
